paragraphs: The F-Pace D200 uses the Ingenium AJ200D — a 2.0-litre four-cylinder diesel engine. It was fitted from the F-Pace's launch in 2016 through the current generation, making it one of the most common diesel options in the range. The AJ200D is a modular diesel design shared across Jaguar and Land Rover models of this era, and while it's a generally reliable unit, the Ingenium diesel family has a documented pattern of timing chain and injector seal wear over time. Knowing which engine you have matters because the components and wear patterns differ between the 2.0-litre diesel and other F-Pace engines — which is exactly why we confirm your exact engine by registration before quoting. Jaguar F-Pace D200 Engine Codes AJ200D A 2.0-litre four-cylinder diesel fitted to the F-Pace D200 from 2016 to the present (X761 generation). Known for timing chain stretch and injector seal wear over time — see the callout above. We replace timing chain components, injector seals, EGR and gaskets as standard on every AJ200D rebuild. Check Your AJ200D F-Pace D200 → [link to quote form] Jaguar F-Pace D200 Engine Compatibility Because the F-Pace range spans multiple engine families across the same generation — including 2.0-litre and 3.0-litre diesels, petrol Ingenium units, and the SVR's supercharged V8 — fitting the wrong replacement or assuming parts from one engine will work on another risks a compatibility problem that's expensive to unpick. cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol mild-hybrid engine fitted to the F-Pace D200 from 2023 to present. The AJ200D features an integrated starter-generator (ISG) and electric auxiliary compressor, making it a more modern and efficient design than the older AJ200D V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every AJ200D rebuild.
